definition: The national standard for describing and measuring English language ability used across Canadian immigration programmes. Niveaux de competence linguistique canadiens (NCLC) is the equivalent French-language scale. Language test results must be converted to a CLB or NCLC level and are only valid for a limited period.
longform: The Federal Skilled Worker Program requires a minimum of CLB 7 in all four abilities — listening, speaking, reading and writing. Verify before publish — confirm current accepted tests and the validity period of results before stating either.
